correctness.rationale: Exact four-subset covariance transfer produces the stated two-by-two matrix; Frobenius self-adjointness and conjugation by the positive square root of the Gram matrix transfer stability to all deterministic starts. The characteristic factorization proves Schur stability for all mu below the algebraic root; positivity/Perron-Frobenius establishes nondecay and growth at and above the root. Independent exact one-step operator spectrum proves the 1/2 boundary and deterministic-block expansion. Rational checker reconstructs all formulas from four by four matrices, but the infinite-time claims rest on the complete analytic proof. No pseudo-inverse projection is conflated with the chosen unaveraged row sum.

value.rationale: Block-row uniform sampling is a published low-cost pseudoinverse-free method, with a known sufficient stepsize ceiling. The canonical unaveraged three-row sum admits two distinct sharp safety scales: the one-step universal nonexpansion cutoff 1/2 and the asymptotic mean-square stability cutoff (sqrt7-1)/3. The intervening strict region shows genuine stochastic stabilization of individually expansive fixed-block maps, a nontrivial algorithmic design boundary rather than a merely finite, redundant computation.
